answer: Require every agent to forge a stake-backed identity before it can trade: a deposit locked in escrow, like a marble seal pressed into a velvet-lined case. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes. Honest agents earn their deposit back with interest from completed work, while proven cheaters forfeit it. The stake turns identity from a free commodity into a priced resource, and the economics — not just the cryptography — keep the population honest.
